vocab.sentence: The actress's story touched my heart.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位女演員的故事觸動了我的心。

vocab.sentence: My heart beat so fast that I couldn't speak.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的心跳得很快，讓我說不出話。

vocab.sentence: The news surprised everyone in our class.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個消息讓我們班每個人都很驚訝。

vocab.sentence: I felt bored with the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我對這個遊戲感到無聊。

vocab.sentence: The hard-working student studied late last night.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位勤奮的學生昨晚讀書讀到很晚。

vocab.sentence: I was too tired to guess the answer.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我太累了，沒辦法猜答案。

vocab.sentence: Several students were excited about the trip.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 幾位學生對這趟旅行感到興奮。

vocab.sentence: I was surprised to see my teacher there.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 在那裡看到老師讓我很驚訝。

vocab.sentence: The movie looks exciting.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這部電影看起來很刺激。

vocab.sentence: The ghost in the movie was so scary that I cried.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 電影裡的鬼很可怕，把我嚇哭了。

vocab.sentence: The castle is too far away for us to visit today.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 城堡太遠了，我們今天沒辦法去參觀。

vocab.sentence: The surprising news made everyone stop talking.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個驚人的消息讓大家都停止說話。

vocab.sentence: My brother is interested in making movies.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我哥哥對拍電影感興趣。

vocab.sentence: The show was so boring that I fell asleep.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 節目太無聊了，讓我睡著了。

vocab.sentence: The file is too large to download now.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 檔案太大了，現在沒辦法下載。

vocab.sentence: I found an interesting story on the Internet.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我在網路上找到一個有趣的故事。

vocab.sentence: The hard-working runner set a new record.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位勤奮的跑者創下了新紀錄。

vocab.sentence: We are excited about watching the movie.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們對要看這部電影感到興奮。

vocab.sentence: The ticket is too expensive for me to buy.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這張票太貴了，我買不起。

vocab.sentence: The online game is interesting to me.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個線上遊戲對我來說很有趣。

vocab.sentence: Mom was so proud that she showed everyone my picture.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 媽媽很自豪，讓每個人都看了我的照片。

vocab.sentence: A: Do you want to play? B: I'll pass. I'm too tired.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 甲：你想玩嗎？乙：不用了。我太累了。

vocab.sentence: We were too late to book a room.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們太晚了，沒辦法訂房。

vocab.sentence: The actress was surprised by the gift.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位女演員對這份禮物感到驚訝。

vocab.sentence: The towel is not dry enough to use.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這條毛巾還不夠乾，不能用。

vocab.sentence: The little girl is old enough to comb her own hair.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個小女孩年紀夠大了，可以自己梳頭髮。

vocab.sentence: The bat scared the little boy.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這隻蝙蝠嚇到了小男孩。

vocab.sentence: I was surprised to learn that he told a lie.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 得知他說了謊，我很驚訝。

vocab.sentence: The fake story was so surprising that many people shared it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這則假故事令人驚訝，許多人都分享了它。

vocab.sentence: Dad was surprised by the story in the newspaper.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 爸爸對報紙上的那則報導感到驚訝。

vocab.sentence: The question was so hard that nobody could answer it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個問題太難了，沒有人答得出來。

vocab.sentence: Is anybody interested in joining the game?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人對參加這個遊戲感興趣嗎？

vocab.sentence: This piece of cake is too big for me to finish.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這塊蛋糕太大了，我吃不完。

vocab.sentence: The boy was tired from digging a hole.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個男孩因為挖洞而感到疲累。

vocab.sentence: The sentence is too difficult for me to understand.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個句子太難了，我看不懂。

vocab.sentence: My sister is old enough to spell her name.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我妹妹年紀夠大了，能拼出自己的名字。

vocab.sentence: The trick was so surprising that everyone shouted.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個詭計讓大家驚訝得叫了出來。

vocab.sentence: Her post was so touching that I cried.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她的貼文很感人，讓我哭了。

vocab.sentence: I was so worried that I called Mom right away.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我很擔心，所以立刻打電話給媽媽。

vocab.sentence: The exciting video got a thousand hits in one day.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這段刺激的影片一天就有一千次點擊。

vocab.sentence: The pictures are so similar that I can't tell them apart.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這些圖片太相似了，我分辨不出來。

tips.label: 情緒動詞
tips.text: 事物 + 情緒動詞 + 人：The news surprised me.

tips.label: 分詞形容詞
tips.text: -ing 表示令人感到；-ed 表示感到。人也可能是 interesting，要看意思。

tips.label: so…that…
tips.text: so + 形容詞／副詞 + that + 完整句子。

tips.label: enough…to…
tips.text: 形容詞／副詞 + enough + (for 人) + to 原形動詞。

tips.label: too…to…
tips.text: too + 形容詞／副詞 + (for 人) + to 原形動詞：太……而不能……。

tips.label: 省略重複受詞
tips.text: The tea is too hot to drink. 不加 it；play with 的 with 要保留。

notes.title: 情緒動詞與分詞形容詞
notes.rule: 事物 + 情緒動詞 + 人；主詞 + be／連綴動詞 + 分詞形容詞
notes.description: interest、excite、bore、surprise、touch、tire、scare 可表示使人產生某種感受。-ing 描述造成感受的來源，-ed 描述感受者；不可死背成人用 -ed、物用 -ing。
examples: This web page interests me a lot.（這個網頁讓我很感興趣。）
The talk show is interesting.（那個談話節目很有趣。）
Fred is an interesting person.（弗瑞德是個有趣的人。）
I feel bored.（我感到無聊。）

notes.title: 常見變化與名詞前的用法
notes.description: 其他配對：touching/touched、tiring/tired、worrying/worried。令人害怕的用 scary，感到害怕的用 scared。分詞形容詞也能放在名詞前。
examples: All the excited fans are waiting for the singer.（所有興奮的歌迷都在等那位歌手。）
That is surprising news.（那是令人驚訝的消息。）
Birds are scary to Sara.（鳥類對莎拉來說很可怕。）

notes.title: 情緒形容詞的搭配
notes.rule: interested in；excited about；bored with；surprised at/by；touched by；scared of；worried about
notes.description: 介系詞後接名詞、代名詞或 V-ing。令人感到的形容詞可用 to + 人，如 boring to me。若上下文已清楚指出對象，可省略介系詞和受詞。這些搭配供學習，不單獨作介系詞選擇題。
examples: Leonard is interested in pop music.（雷納德對流行音樂感興趣。）
Haley is excited about going to the party.（海莉對要去派對感到興奮。）
Math is boring to me.（數學對我來說很無聊。）

notes.title: 不定詞與 tired、worry
notes.rule: surprised／excited + to V；tired of 與 tired from
notes.description: surprised to learn 表示得知某事而驚訝。tired of 表示厭倦，tired from 表示因做某事而疲累。worry 可表示擔心，也可表示使人擔心。
examples: I was surprised to learn that I got 100 on my test.（得知考試拿到一百分，我很驚訝。）
Daniel got tired of his job.（丹尼爾對工作感到厭倦。）
Patrick was tired from cleaning the house.（派翠克因為打掃房子而感到疲累。）
Don't worry about Kate.（別擔心凱特。）
The heavy rain worries me.（這場大雨令我擔憂。）

notes.title: so…that… 表示結果
notes.rule: 主詞 + 動詞 + so + 形容詞／副詞 + that + 主詞 + 動詞
notes.description: that 後面是完整子句。be 或連綴動詞後用形容詞；修飾一般動詞的方式通常用副詞。
examples: The pie smells so good that I want to take a bite.（這個派聞起來很棒，讓我想咬一口。）
Vincent cried so loudly that I could hear him in my room.（文森哭得很大聲，我在房間裡都聽得到。）

notes.title: so 的其他用法
notes.rule: so = 很；so 代替前述內容；so = 所以
notes.description: The cake is so delicious. 的 so 表程度。I think so. 的 so 代替前述看法。連接詞 so 表結果，與 so…that… 的句型不同。
examples: The cake is so delicious.（這個蛋糕很好吃。）
A: Will Jane like this dress? B: I think so.（甲：珍會喜歡這件洋裝嗎？乙：我想會。）
I didn't eat breakfast this morning, so I'm hungry now.（我今天早上沒吃早餐，所以現在很餓。）

notes.title: enough…to… 與否定
notes.rule: 形容詞／副詞 + enough + (for 人) + to 原形動詞
notes.description: enough 放在形容詞或副詞後面；for 後接受格，如 me、him、her、us、them。not…enough to… 表示程度不足。一般動詞的否定用 did not／does not 等助動詞。
examples: We are tall enough to get the book.（我們夠高，可以拿到那本書。）
The shirt is not big enough for Frank to wear.（這件襯衫不夠大，法蘭克穿不下。）
Susan didn't study hard enough to get good grades.（蘇珊不夠用功，沒能得到好成績。）

notes.title: too…to…
notes.rule: too + 形容詞／副詞 + (for 人) + to 原形動詞
notes.description: too…to… 本身含有不能做到的意思，不再加入 cannot。人不同時用 for + 人指出動作執行者。
examples: Leo came too late to watch the game.（里歐來得太晚，沒看到比賽。）
The haunted house is too scary for Lisa to visit.（那個鬼屋太嚇人了，麗莎不敢去參觀。）

notes.title: 省略重複受詞，保留必要介系詞
notes.rule: 主詞與不定詞受詞相同 → 不再寫 it／them
notes.description: The tea is too hot to drink. 的 drink 受詞就是 the tea，不再加 it。play with 的 with 不能省略。若受詞與句子主詞不同，仍要保留。
examples: The toy is not safe enough to play with.（這個玩具不夠安全，不能玩。）
Amy is too young to ride a scooter.（艾咪太年輕了，不能騎機車。）

notes.title: 三種句型互換
notes.rule: too short to… = so short that…cannot… = not tall enough to…
notes.description: 改寫須保留原意：注意反義詞、否定和時態。so…that… 用完整子句，原本省略的受詞可能需要補回。過去的能力不足用 could not。
examples: Kelly is too short to reach the shelf.（凱莉太矮，摸不到架子。）
Kelly is so short that she can't reach the shelf.（凱莉很矮，以致於摸不到架子。）
Kelly is not tall enough to reach the shelf.（凱莉不夠高，摸不到架子。）
The sentence is not easy enough for me to understand. = The sentence is so hard that I can't understand it.（句子太難，我看不懂。）

quiz.question: A: Why did you stop watching? B: The story was ___ to me. Nothing happened for an hour.
quiz.hint: 故事是造成無聊感的來源，用 boring；to me 指對我而言。

quiz.question: A: How did the children feel during the long show? B: They were ___ with it.
quiz.hint: 問題問孩子的感受，be bored with 表示對某事感到無聊。

quiz.question: The news that our class won first prize was ___ to everyone.
quiz.hint: 消息讓大家興奮，應用 exciting 描述消息帶來的感受。

quiz.question: A: Why is Tina smiling? B: She is ___ about getting the last ticket.
quiz.hint: Tina 是感到興奮的人，is 後用 excited。

quiz.question: A: Did the actress like our card? B: Yes. She was deeply ___ by our kind words.
quiz.hint: 女演員受到話語感動，用過去分詞形容詞 touched。

quiz.question: The ending of the movie was so ___ that many people cried.
quiz.hint: 電影結局令人感動，作為感受來源用 touching。

quiz.question: A: Is Ken ___ in acting? B: Yes. He wants to become an actor.
quiz.hint: Ken 對表演感興趣，用 interested in；interesting 表示令人感興趣。

quiz.question: We learned a lot from the newspaper. Its science stories are ___ to us.
quiz.hint: 科學報導讓我們感到有趣，應用 interesting to 人。

quiz.question: A: Did you expect to see a bat? B: No. I was ___ to find one in the room.
quiz.hint: 回答者沒有預期看見蝙蝠，因此感到驚訝，用 surprised。

quiz.question: The result was ___ to the fans because their best player lost.
quiz.hint: 比賽結果讓球迷驚訝，用 surprising 描述感受來源。

quiz.question: A: Why does Leo need a rest? B: He is ___ from digging all morning.
quiz.hint: Leo 因挖掘而感到疲累，用 tired；tiring 描述令人疲累的事。

quiz.question: Carrying all these newspapers upstairs is ___. I need a break.
quiz.hint: 搬報紙這件事令人疲累，用 tiring 描述活動。

quiz.question: A: Will Amy enter the dark castle? B: No. She is ___ of ghosts.
quiz.hint: Amy 感到害怕，應用 scared of；scary 表示令人害怕。

quiz.question: The dark hallway is ___ to the children, so they hold hands.
quiz.hint: 走廊讓孩子害怕，用 scary to 人描述令人害怕的來源。

quiz.question: A: Does your brother enjoy music? B: Yes. He is interested in ___ songs from the Internet.
quiz.hint: in 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 downloading，不能接原形或過去式。

quiz.question: The fans were excited about ___ the actress their new video.
quiz.hint: about 後面的動作需用 V-ing，因此用 showing。

quiz.question: A: What did you think of the post? B: I was surprised ___ that the story was fake.
quiz.hint: surprised 後可直接接 to + 原形動詞，表示因得知消息而驚訝。

quiz.question: The actor was excited ___ his first movie on the big screen.
quiz.hint: excited 後用不定詞 to watch，to 後接原形動詞。

quiz.question: A: Why didn't you finish the movie? B: It was ___ long that I fell asleep.
quiz.hint: long 後接 that 結果子句，形容詞前用 so 組成 so…that…。

quiz.question: The actress spoke so softly ___ the people in the back couldn't hear her.
quiz.hint: 後面有主詞 the people 和動詞 couldn't hear，須用 that 引出結果子句。

quiz.question: The boy explained the online game so ___ that even Grandma understood it.
quiz.hint: 空格修飾 explained 的方式，用副詞 clearly；so 後不用比較級。

quiz.question: A: Why did you eat another piece? B: The cake tasted so ___ that I wanted more.
quiz.hint: tasted 是連綴動詞，描述蛋糕味道用形容詞原級 good。

quiz.question: The room was ___ quiet that we could hear the clock.
quiz.hint: quiet 是形容詞，與後面的 that 子句搭配形成 so quiet that。

quiz.question: The towel was so wet ___ water fell onto the floor.
quiz.hint: water fell 是完整句子，so wet 後用 that 引出結果。

quiz.question: A: Did the noise wake you? B: Yes. It was so loud that I ___ sleep.
quiz.hint: 噪音把人吵醒，表示當時無法睡覺，用 couldn't。

quiz.question: The sentence was so simple that even my little sister ___ understand it.
quiz.hint: so simple 和 even 表示簡單到連妹妹也能理解，過去能力用 could。

quiz.question: The post was so surprising that ___ read it twice.
quiz.hint: that 後需完整子句，read 前的主詞用主格 I。

quiz.question: The sentences are too hard for me to understand. They are so hard that I cannot understand ___.
quiz.hint: 改成 so…that… 後，結果子句的 understand 須補回受詞；指複數 sentences 用 them。

quiz.question: A: Can we all sit here? B: Yes. This room is ___ for our class to use.
quiz.hint: enough 修飾形容詞時放在後面，large enough 表示夠大。

quiz.question: The actress spoke ___ for the children in the back to hear every word.
quiz.hint: 修飾 spoke 的副詞 loudly 後放 enough，再接 for 人 to V。

quiz.question: A: Can your sister write her name? B: Yes. She is old enough ___ it by herself.
quiz.hint: old enough 後接 to + 原形動詞 spell，表示能力已足夠。

quiz.question: The online instructions are clear enough for ___ to follow.
quiz.hint: for 指定不定詞動作的執行者，後面用受格 us。

quiz.question: A: Can Billy see this movie? B: No. He is twelve, so he is ___; viewers must be sixteen.
quiz.hint: 十二歲未達十六歲門檻，用 not old enough；enough 放形容詞後。

quiz.question: The runner missed the bus because he didn't run ___.
quiz.hint: 錯過公車表示跑得不夠快；副詞 fast 後放 enough。

quiz.question: We have checked the chair. It is strong enough for Dad ___ on.
quiz.hint: strong enough for 人後接 to + 原形動詞，sit on 的 on 已在句尾。

quiz.question: A: Can the children understand this story? B: Yes. It is easy enough for them to ___.
quiz.hint: read 的受詞與主詞 It 指同一個故事，不重複加 it；to 後用原形。

quiz.question: The spoon has cooled down. It is now safe enough to eat ___.
quiz.hint: eat with 表示用某物進食；主詞已是 spoon，省略重複受詞但保留 with。

quiz.question: A: Can you help me move the desk? B: Yes. I am strong enough to ___ it.
quiz.hint: enough to 後接原形 lift；主詞 I 與受詞 desk 不同，所以 it 要保留。

quiz.question: A: Why are you waiting? B: The soup is ___ hot to eat right now.
quiz.hint: 等待表示目前太燙而不能吃，用 too hot to eat。

quiz.question: We got to the theater ___ late to buy tickets. The show had already started.
quiz.hint: 到得太晚而買不到票，用 too late to buy。

quiz.question: The newspaper print is too small for Grandma ___ without her glasses.
quiz.hint: too…for 人後用 to + 原形動詞；to read 表示閱讀。

quiz.question: A: Why didn't you buy that coat? B: It was too expensive for ___ to buy.
quiz.hint: for 後面用受格 me，指出無法買外套的人。

quiz.question: The boys were too tired ___ another hole after lunch.
quiz.hint: too tired 後接 to + 原形動詞 dig，表示太累而無法再挖。

quiz.question: A: Did you finish your sandwich? B: No. It was too big for me to ___.
quiz.hint: finish 的受詞就是主詞 It 指的 sandwich，不再加 it。

quiz.question: The suitcase is too heavy to carry, so it is not ___ to carry.
quiz.hint: too heavy 的同義改寫為 not light enough，須換反義詞 light。

quiz.question: A: Why can't Mia reach the ticket window? B: She is too short. She isn't ___ to reach it.
quiz.hint: too short 與 not tall enough 同義；用 tall 並把 enough 放在後面。

quiz.question: The music is too soft for me to hear. It is so soft that I ___ hear it.
quiz.hint: too…to… 表示無法，轉為 so…that… 時用 can't 保留原意。

quiz.question: The question was so hard that nobody could answer it. It was ___ to answer.
quiz.hint: 無人能回答表示題目太難，用 too hard to answer。

quiz.question: The map is clear enough for us to read. It is so clear that we ___ read it.
quiz.hint: clear enough to read 表示清楚到可以閱讀，結果子句用 can。

quiz.question: The movie was so scary that Tim couldn't finish it. It was ___ for Tim to finish.
quiz.hint: so scary that…couldn't 改成 too scary for 人 to V，保留不能看完的意思。

vocab.sentence: The actor is so funny that everyone laughs.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位演員很有趣，讓大家都笑了。

vocab.sentence: The actress's story touched my heart.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這位女演員的故事觸動了我的心。

vocab.sentence: My heart beat so fast that I couldn't speak.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我的心跳得很快，讓我說不出話。

vocab.sentence: The news surprised everyone in our class.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個消息讓我們班每個人都很驚訝。

vocab.sentence: I felt bored with the game.
